'''Gully rats''' were a type of [[Rat/Legends|rat]] that thrived on heat and waste, byproducts of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] life. It could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Y:DR" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'' to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> while on the world, the [[Tac-Spec Corporation|Tac-Spec]] [[FIII Footman droid]] [[Solis]] thought about how gully rats, among other creatures, had adapted to living amongst the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]].<ref name="Y:DR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gully rats were mentioned in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'', written by [[Sean Stewart]].<ref name="Y:DR" />
